text_block_list.text:
One day, we bump into Эйсин Флэш out
in town.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Falcon. Are the two of you on an
outing?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ Even an Umadol has to take a
breather
every now and then! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I heard your trainer helped you with your
studies.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So the reason Falcon has needed fewer
extra
classes must be thanks to your
tutelage.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Flash! You can't just go around
in public
blurting out stuff about an
Umadol needing extra
classes!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? I just meant to say
that your
trainer must be an excellent
instructor.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Geez... Flash can sure be clueless
sometimes. Did
she really have to say
that?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: So you've been doing well at school?

text_block_list.text:
Well, the less extra classes I have to
take, the
more I can concentrate on
training and
performing, right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's still a very long way to go until I
become a
top Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As I thought, she's actively trying her
hardest to
overcome her weaknesses. In
that case...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
How about I take you out for a change of
scenery as a reward?

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! No way! ♪ Ooh, wherever
should
we go...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
How about a trip down memory lane?
It'll be like
a Falco pilgrimage! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, do you remember that first tryout
race we
faced as a team?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's the same track I always run on, but
there's still
something nostalgic about
it. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I spent so much time practicing karaoke,
I can
even sing rock and enka now. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I need to be able to cover any genre if I
want to
be a first-rate Umadol! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
This was where we first met, at my street

performance.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...It's thanks to you that I can give my all
in both
running and performing.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I hope you know just how grateful I am
for that! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a gorgeous sunset! It makes
me want
to sing. ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон looks as brilliant as when I
saw her
perform for the first time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I'm glad I became your trainer.

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон looks as brilliant as when I
saw her
perform for the first time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I'm glad I became your trainer.

text_block_list.text:
Call my name and I'll turn around! ☆ I'll
shine
right on your heart! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm the cutest Umadol! ☆ Full of
sparkling
dreams! ☆ Смарт Фалкон! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ♪ You're the best call and
response
partner in the whole wide
world, Trainer! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It's because I've got tons of experience.

text_block_list.text:
True! ☆ I'm so glad to have you as my
first fan,
always helping me chase my
dreams! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I find myself clapping.
Her
singing and dancing have both
improved, and she
shines brighter than
ever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ehe! ☆ Thanks! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let me give you something special as
thanks for
your support! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Are you ready? ☆ Three, two, one! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Click!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Trainer! A photo for my
number one
fan, to remember today's
pilgrimage by! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too. I'm so happy that you're
my
trainer...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't for you, I'd still be limiting
myself to
only turf...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I would never have realized that I could
shine as
an Umadol by racing on dirt as
well.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...Eheheh. It's a bit embarrassing to come
out and
say this kinda stuff, huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I still think I need more experience
to become
a top Umadol.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's still a long road ahead... but I
can keep
going because you're by my
side.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let's make a lot more memories from
here on out,
okay? ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work even harder from here on
out, so
stay by my side! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
